text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-Christian Maronite Patriarch Sfeir asks Lebanese officials about the wide campaign of arrests launched by security forces in the last 13 days "Is it by violating human rights that we preserve Lebanon's image".

-The solution for the Israeli occupation zone in South Lebanon is to have Israel respect Lebanon's sovereignty on all its territories and Lebanon's relation with Syria, Eygpt's Foreign Minister Moussa said.
-French President Chirac "Man of the Year," is As-safir's choice.
-French President Chirac says "Lebanon is the pillar of our Arab and Mediterranean policy".
-Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu is an enemy to Lebanon, Chairman of the Christian Liberal Nationalist right-wing party Chamoun said.
-Minister of Defence Dalloul said the arrest campaign was done in accordance to the judicial procedures.
-Lebanon maintained a low percentage of economic growth and high percentage of unemployment, Lebanon's Banks Association stated in its annual report.
